meta_description:
1,724 likes, 28 comments - 91mobiles on October 6, 2026: "The iPhone 18 Pro Max has arrived, but is it actually the best camera phone among the latest flagship competition? We put it up against the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra and Google Pixel 11 Pro XL to find out.

Across daylight, 5x zoom, ultrawide, portraits, selfies and low-light shots, each phone had its own strengths.

The Galaxy S26 Ultra ultimately came out on top for its consistent output, while the Pixel 11 Pro XL won us over with its natural colours and zoom performance. The iPhone 18 Pro Max, meanwhile, was the clear winner for portraits.

Read our full comparison to see how all three phones performed in each scenario. (Link in bio)

So, which smartphone would you pick if the camera is your priority? Choose your favourite in the poll below!".
